entries.02fd1eb20ae8b45c: All stores are completely reserved venues with one chapel, one party hall and one kitchen, so the whole venue, including the garden and terrace, can be used for staging, and because the stores are small, they can be opened from large cities to suburbs. Each couple is handled by one planner from first visit to the wedding day, and because food, dresses, photography and video are all handled within the group, the quality of the whole wedding can be kept consistent in-house.

entries.255ab5ea59dcbf4e: At fully private guest houses, the company plans and operates ceremonies and receptions. All stores are in the style of "1 chapel, 1 party venue, 1 kitchen," and freshly prepared French cuisine is served from an open kitchen attached to the party venue. The company adopts a "consistent wedding planner system," in which 1 wedding planner handles everything from the couple's first visit through meetings to support on the wedding day. The company operates 25 venues, centered on the Tokai region, and sales in the fiscal year ended July 2026 were ¥14,300,001,000 plus ¥5,000,000.
entries.280b6169ce985284: Consolidated subsidiary lyrics Inc. produces wedding video products, photo products and graphic design. Brass Corporation commissions photo and video production from the company.
entries.347d2e5c1fed6aa6: Under its corporate philosophy, 'Creating the best wedding for each bride and groom,' the company says it will maintain the wedding style it has upheld since its founding: completely reserved guesthouses, a system in which one wedding planner handles each couple throughout, and open kitchens. To increase 'good weddings,' it aims to grow by opening new wedding venues nationwide, to raise the number of customers attracted and the contract rate through advertising strategies and effective investment in store displays, and to raise the quality of weddings by further expanding in-house operations such as cooking wedding meals, running dress shops, and photography and video production.

entries.93bd9836e7225fdb: In the wedding industry, the number of ceremonies and receptions has been gradually declining against a backdrop of declining birthrates and a shrinking population of marriageable age, while guesthouse weddings are gaining support as demand grows for original ceremonies and receptions. Brass Corporation operates 25 venues mainly in the Tokai region and is a wedding operator specializing in guesthouse weddings, in which the company on a non-consolidated basis accounts for about 98% of group revenue.

entries.dc9236e4bbd1369e: Funds for new store openings come from the profits of existing stores, and the structure rests on two pillars: maintaining and expanding the profits of existing stores and opening new stores. Store formats are divided into three types (suburban, urban, and city-center tenant), chosen to match the population size of each area, which allows stores to be opened from large cities to suburbs with small populations.
